mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY price
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_sku (product_id, spec_name, price, stock, status) VALUES (#{productId}, #{specName}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku SET spec_name = #{specName}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock - #{count} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{count}
UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock + #{count} WHERE id = #{id}
